code_objects.label: Proof Case 0001 block A
code_objects.description: 24-bp E. coli/Pyrococcus block containing a nested 16-bp core also found in yeast.

code_objects.label: Proof Case 0001 nested core
code_objects.description: 16-bp core nested inside PC1-BLOCK-A24 and observed across bacterium, archaeon and eukaryote.

code_objects.label: Proof Case 0001 block B
code_objects.description: Second 25-bp block recurring near block A in five E. coli copies and one Pyrococcus copy.

code_objects.label: Proof Case 0001 spatial module
code_objects.orientation_semantics: A before B; observed start spacings near 3 kb
code_objects.description: Annotation-blind nested/spatial module; post-freeze annotation mapped it to large-rRNA organization, with the yeast core in mitochondrial 21S LSU rRNA.

code_objects.label: Proof Case 0002 BLOCK_C
code_objects.description: Frozen before annotation; coding-oriented TTCCACGGTGGTTCCGGTTCTACTG, coding start 789 in both genes.

code_objects.label: Proof Case 0002 BLOCK_D
code_objects.description: Frozen before annotation; coding-oriented ACCGGTGGTGAAGAAGA, coding start 534 in both genes.

code_objects.label: Proof Case 0002 conserved metabolic module
code_objects.orientation_semantics: two colinear exact blocks on same coordinate diagonal; raw starts 263 bp apart
code_objects.description: Sole non-mitochondrial high-complexity multi-block colinear cluster; later annotation mapped both blocks to class-II FBA genes.

code_objects.label: Flat exact fixed-length universal dictionary
code_objects.description: No valid tested flat exact-k dictionary beat raw 2-bit/base coding after dictionary/reference costs.

code_objects.label: Exact-gap grammar
code_objects.description: Zero held-out module transfer in every deep-domain pilot fold.

code_objects.label: Ordered 10-kb two-primitive grammar
code_objects.orientation_semantics: 16-mer A occurs before 16-mer B within 10 kb
code_objects.description: Training pairs contained 540/989/1395 modules, but zero transferred to held-out third domain in all three folds; zero transfers in 30 shuffled null genomes.

edges.notes: Same raw start-to-start spacing in E. coli and yeast; same genome-to-genome coordinate diagonal.

claims.claim_text: Annotation-blind exact-recurrence discovery can recover known reusable biological sequence architecture before semantic labeling.
claims.boundary_text: Method validation only; not a universal instruction set or publication-level novelty.

claims.claim_text: The pilot does not establish a universal biological word length.
claims.boundary_text: Three genomes and exact identity only.

claims.claim_text: One flat universal exact fixed-length dictionary is insufficient under the tested complete three-fold compression calibration.
claims.boundary_text: Falsifies this abstraction, not reusable genomic structure generally.

claims.claim_text: The tested unchanged two-primitive ordered-within-10-kb grammar did not transfer across the deeply separated third domain.
claims.boundary_text: Does not prove higher-order biological function is unconserved; only that this representation failed.
